footer.connect: Connecting citizens with their Gram Panchayat — transparent, accountable, and accessible rural governance.

landing.heroTitle: A smarter way to connect citizens with their Gram Panchayat
landing.heroSubtitle: Report local issues with photo evidence, follow every complaint from submission to resolution, read official panchayat notices, and discover the government schemes your household is entitled to — all from one trusted place.
landing.whyTitle: Everything your village needs, in one place
landing.whySubtitle: One platform connecting citizens, panchayat staff, and government services — replacing paper registers and word-of-mouth with a transparent digital record.
landing.feature1Desc: Log road damage, water outages, sanitation problems and more — with a photo and your location attached.
landing.feature2Desc: Follow your complaint from submission to resolution on a clear timeline. No more guessing where it stands.
landing.feature3Desc: Automatic email alerts whenever the panchayat acts on your complaint — filed, assigned, or resolved.
landing.feature4Desc: Gram sabha meetings, water schedules, and important announcements — published and archived in one place.
landing.feature5Desc: A curated directory of welfare schemes — PM Awas, PM Kisan, MGNREGA, Jal Jeevan Mission — with eligibility explained simply.
landing.feature6Desc: Staff get an operations console with complaint analytics, so nothing goes unseen and nothing goes unanswered.
landing.howSubtitle: From noticing a problem to seeing it fixed — three simple steps, fully tracked.
landing.step1Desc: Pick a category, describe the problem, and attach a photo as evidence. It takes less than two minutes.
landing.step2Desc: Staff review your complaint, assign it to the right department, and post updates as work happens.
landing.step3Desc: Follow the timeline from submission to resolution. You always know exactly where things stand.
landing.trackingTitle: Every complaint has a paper trail
landing.trackingDesc: No more chasing officials or wondering what happened. Each complaint gets a unique ID and a transparent, timestamped history of every action taken.
landing.trackingPoint1: Unique complaint ID for every report
landing.trackingPoint2: Timestamped status history with official remarks
landing.trackingPoint3: Email alerts when the status changes
landing.schemesSubtitle: Central welfare schemes explained simply — what you get and who qualifies.
landing.noticesSubtitle: Official announcements from your Gram Panchayat, published and archived.
landing.transparencyDesc: A public record means fewer things get lost. Complaints, notices, and scheme information stay visible and accountable.
landing.impactDesc: A broken street light reported today is a repaired street light next week. When neighbours report issues through one shared system, the panchayat can prioritise what matters most to the whole village.
landing.trustSubtitle: Your reports and personal details deserve the same protection as any government record.
landing.trust1Desc: Sign-in sessions use secure, HTTP-only cookies — credentials are never exposed to the browser.
landing.trust2Desc: Data is stored in Amazon DynamoDB with media in S3, on the same cloud used by banks and governments.
landing.trust3Desc: Only panchayat administrators can change complaint statuses — every change is attributed and logged.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to make your village better?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join your neighbours on SmartGram — report issues, follow fixes, and stay connected with your Gram Panchayat.
